name: CRASH OUT!
tagline: An AR drum kit on smart glasses with real-time hardware, for drumming anywhere.

awards: Snap: Spectacles AR Hackathon: Game On!

problem: Small apartments, neighbours and budgets keep people from drums.
solution: AR glasses render a drum kit; a microcontroller and real-time OS with physical parts handle hits and sound.
demo_moment: Team-described: drum on thin air and hear the kit.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Snap: Spectacles AR Hackathon: Game On!” among 261 submissions.
Combined three sponsors' hardware in one project.

lessons: Music demos are loud, short and memorable on a judging floor.
